summary: Master institutional transformation in central banking. Learn ADKAR®, Kotter’s, and CBDC rollout strategies in this 5-day expert-led course. Enroll today.
lede: Central bank change management helps project, technology, HR and risk professionals plan institutional updates while maintaining continuity. The training covers readiness and impact assessment, transformation roadmaps for system upgrades, and governance, risk controls and stakeholder communication. Practical exercises include mapping stakeholders and drafting communications for change initiatives.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for maintaining institutional continuity while implementing critical updates to systems, processes, and structures.
audience: HR Transformation Specialists focused on workforce
modules: Central Bank Transformation Context and Drivers
Leading Digital Transformation and CBDC Rollouts
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in central banking, financial regulation, or project management. Familiarity with basic organizational structures and a general understanding of payment systems or monetary policy operations is recommended. No prior formal certification in change management is required, though exposure to project management methodologies is beneficial.
